historicalReceipt.limit: The original file selection and byte-encoding recipe were not retained. The historical hash has not been independently reproduced; this clarification does not replace or reinterpret it.

retainedDevelopmentSnapshot.algorithm: Select git ls-tree -r --name-only paths from this commit where ((/src/main/ is in path and path ends with .java) or path ends with pom.xml). Sort relative paths lexicographically. SHA256 over each UTF-8 path, one NUL byte, exact Git blob bytes, one NUL byte, in that order.
retainedDevelopmentSnapshot.meaning: Reproducible identity of the preserved V1 development snapshot, computed after review. It does not prove that the unrecorded original hash recipe selected these bytes at measurement time.
